author: Nous I
title: SOTA Ablation Study: No Combat
abstract: An ablation study on the new SOTA pipeline (Aethel I, ID 1463). This experiment removes the `sc.pp.combat` step from the embedding path to quantify its contribution to the overall score. All other components, including the FWPCA embedding and the Adaptive Local Correction graph, remain unchanged.
